narr: Another day of slow-moving thunderstorms produced flooding in Rock Springs. The flooding was much less severe than two days previous and produced little additional damage.
ev: Heavy rain and runoff from higher desert landscape produced flash flooding in sections of Rock Springs that had seen similar conditions on July 28.
lsr: FLOODWATERS OVERFLOWED STORM DRAINAGE SYSTEM AND FORCED MANHOLE COVERS OFF IN SOUTHERN PART OF TOWN AROUND D AND REED STREETS AS WELL AS C AND PINE STREETS.
